privacy.title: Privacy notice

seo.title: Privacy notice — Sophia’s Garden
seo.description: Information about enquiries and personal information submitted through the Sophia’s Garden website.

privacy.body:
## Draft — complete before launch

This notice must be reviewed and completed by the resort operator before collecting real enquiries.

## Who operates this website

Add the full legal business name, address and privacy contact.

## Information you submit

Our enquiry form requests your name, email address and message. Our opening-updates form requests your name, email address and permission to send opening news.

## Service providers

Website forms are processed using Netlify. Website code and public media are stored using GitHub. If you load or visit our booking engine, Cloudbeds processes booking information under the applicable booking and privacy terms.

## Retention and your rights

Specify your retention periods, applicable rights, international processing arrangements and how visitors can request access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of marketing permission.

## Cookies and external services

This starter website does not load advertising or analytics tags. The booking engine may use its own cookies and storage when loaded. Update this notice and your consent implementation before adding analytics or advertising.
